args.title: Fix password reset email link URL to not use localhost
args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

Change the base URL used in email templates from a default of http://localhost:3000 to a safer default or ensure it picks up the correct environment variable. This fixes the issue where password reset emails sent in production contain a link to localhost, which is inaccessible to users. Instead, it should link to the actual deployed public URL for the app.
